is_anopheles.evidence: Studies three major malaria vector species: Anopheles gambiae, An. coluzzii, and An. arabiensis (Page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Models spatiotemporal trends in Vgsc-995F and Vgsc-995S target-site resistance mutations (Page 1-2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not report raw, site-specific genotype counts or extractable sample frequencies from new empirical collections; it uses a collated database of 2418 previously published/contributed observations to fit geostatistical models (Page 1, 12).

african_field_population.evidence: Data encompasses field sampled mosquitoes collected from 27 African countries spanning western and eastern regions (Page 1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a secondary geostatistical modelling study re-analysing collated database and literature observations rather than a primary empirical field study (Page 1, 12).

sub_country_location.evidence: Predictions and collated sampling locations are tied to specific sub-country geographic locations and spatial grids (~5 km resolution) across 9 focal countries (Page 1, 12).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Models spatiotemporal trends over the period 2005-2017 with annual resolution (Page 1, 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The dataset used is an updated version of a publicly available dataset collating data from multiple published and unpublished contributors (Moyes et al. 2019 [47]) (Page 12).

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data extraction needed because the study itself is an ineligible secondary modelling study.

assessment.summary: This paper presents a Bayesian statistical spatiotemporal model ensemble to map annual species-specific frequencies of Vgsc-995F and Vgsc-995S across nine sub-Saharan African countries between 2005 and 2017. Because it relies on a collated database of previously published/contributed sample observations for secondary geospatial modelling rather than presenting primary field genotyping data, it is not eligible for primary data extraction.
exclusion_reasons: is_primary_study: Paper is a geostatistical modelling study re-analysing collated/published datasets rather than reporting new empirical primary data.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: Does not report raw extractable site-level genotype counts or sample frequencies from primary empirical collections.
